findings.description: The functions process_user and process_admin contain identical logic, leading to code duplication.
Code duplication detected: process_user and process_admin perform identical logic for sanitizing user/admin input, violating the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle.

reasons: The candidate successfully refactored the code to use a single normalization function, effectively resolving the identified code duplication issues.
The implementation is clean, readable, and maintains the original behavior as confirmed by the passing test suite.
No security vulnerabilities were introduced; the use of str() and strip().lower() is safe for the intended purpose of data normalization.
The maintainability score is high because the code is now DRY and follows standard Python practices.
